How Control Center works
Everything goes through Windows and your PC's own drivers. Nothing else to install.
1

Screen and sound

Sliders for the built-in screen and the speakers or headphones in use.

  • Brightness of the built-in display
  • Volume and Mute
  • No administrator rights
2

Wi-Fi and Bluetooth

Switch the radios, then handle networks and devices right in the panel:

  • Join, disconnect, forget networks
  • Search and pair, PIN shown in the panel
  • Remove paired devices
3

Battery limit

On ASUS handhelds and laptops, one switch keeps the battery from charging past 80%.

  • Checked read-only at start
  • Written only when you flip it
  • Off sets it back to 100%
Safe by design Sections without the hardware stay hidden, and Wi-Fi passwords are never logged or put on a command line.
